name: turn-flow-legacy-projection-closeout
title: Retire live turn-flow legacy back-projection
description: Stop mutating canonical assistant turnFlow back into legacy chat message fields across the live frontend chat runtime.
creator: yudi
notes: 2026-04-21 full-repo audit confirmed that the frontend chat runtime still called `reconcileTurnFlowWithLegacy()` and `applyLegacyFieldsFromTurnFlow()` through live SSE, lifecycle, and finalize paths, repopulating canonical `turnFlow` into legacy `thinkingContent`, `optimizingTools`, `ragSources`, and `toolCalls`. 2026-04-21 closeout completed the live SSE/lifecycle writers: canonical `turnFlow` became the only live writable truth, display selectors read canonical flow first, and native-search/tool-call finalization stopped dual-writing top-level legacy fields whenever canonical flow exists. 2026-04-22 audit follow-up closed the remaining persisted-history seam in merge/finalize: assistant messages that already carry `turnFlow` now absorb bounded legacy `thinkingContent`, `ragSources`, and `toolCalls` into canonical flow only when needed, then delete the top-level duplicates so history/finalize no longer emits two competing truths for the same turn. Verified with `pnpm --dir frontend exec vitest run apps/web-antd/src/components/business/ai-chat-panel/__tests__/use-ai-chat.test.ts`.
